story.jaymoskingdoms.born.title: Where were you born?
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.sub: Your blood and the land that bore you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.plains.tale: You were born among the wheat of the open plains, where the days are long and the bread is honest: plain folk, the kind the old stories never stop to name.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.mountain: A mining hold inside the mountain
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.mountain.tale: You were born in a hold carved deep into the mountain, where the walls hum and no one fears the dark.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.mountain.short: A hold deep in the mountain.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.coast: An unknown oasis by a water temple
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.coast.tale: Nobody knows quite where you were born: you were found at a hidden oasis by an old water temple, already at home in the water.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.coast.short: Found by an old water temple.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.forest.tale: You were born under the canopy of the old forest, where the trees are older than any realm and your elders remember some of them as saplings.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.valley: A whole world of plains, moss and vines
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.valley.tale: You were born in a whole world of plains, moss and vines, where things grow back faster than they fall.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.valley.short: A world of moss and vines.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.forge: On an expedition outside the Nether
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.forge.tale: You were born on an expedition just outside the Nether, and its heat never quite left you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.north.tale: You were born in the snowfields your people settled when they came from far past the sun. To you the cold is just weather, and the old ones still call somewhere colder home.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.moors: The moors, where the sun barely rises
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.moors.tale: You were born on the grey moors, where the sun barely clears the hills and the nights belong to your people.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.moors.short: The grey moors, where nights are yours.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.warband.tale: You were born in a warband's camp that never stayed anywhere long, a blade within reach of your cradle. The old ones never said where the band first came from, only that it was a long way up.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.scholars: A city of scholars and towers
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.scholars.tale: You were born in a city of towers and libraries, where everyone argued and nothing was ever settled.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.scholars.short: A city of towers and libraries.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.temple.tale: You were born on the high desert, woken every morning by the first light on the sand.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.temple.short: The high desert, at first light.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.shrine: A hilltop shrine above the clouds
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.shrine.tale: You were born at a shrine so high the clouds were underfoot, and the first thing you remember is the light.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.vats: A workshop's vats, and no mother to name
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.vats.tale: You were grown in the Mad Tinkerer's vats from borrowed blood, stitched, tested and never quite finished, and let out into the world with a name someone chose for you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.fair: A travelling fair, among the strange folk
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.fair.tale: You were born in a wagon of a travelling fair, among the acrobats and the oddities, where bending the rules was the act.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.den: A den in the wild lands
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.den.tale: You were born in a den among the roots and rocks of the wild lands, warm in a heap of your kin, with the whole night to listen to.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.den.short: A den in the wild lands.
